verdict.rationale: Devin exposes a documented API for creating sessions, acting on behalf of users, and (via its MCP server) managing playbooks, knowledge, and schedules, showing substantial parity with core UI workflows, but there's no evidence the full UI feature set (e.g., Interactive Browser takeover, IDE handoff, Terminal session interactivity, Slack/Teams tagging) is API-addressable, and no discoverable OpenAPI spec confirming full endpoint coverage. missing for 10: OpenAPI/spec proving full endpoint parity, API equivalents for Interactive Browser/IDE/terminal UI actions, independent confirmation of complete UI-API parity.
